methods.name: Apply
methods.description:
Create or update a session.
 The authorization and state-operation are determined depending on whether the session
 is going to be created or updated which is determined as part of the request execution.

methods.name: Create
methods.description:
Create a new session for an agent.
 Requires can_create_session permission in the organization.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Update an existing session (e.g., subject, thread_id, sandbox_id).

methods.name: UpdateSubject
methods.description:
Set the session subject (server-side field-level update, race-safe).

 Unlike the full update RPC, this atomically modifies only spec.subject
 without touching other fields. This eliminates the lost-update race
 between GenerateSessionSubject and sandbox_manager, which both run in
 parallel during agent execution.

methods.name: UpdateSandboxId
methods.description:
Set the session sandbox ID (server-side field-level update, race-safe).

 Unlike the full update RPC, this atomically modifies only spec.sandbox_id
 without touching other fields. This eliminates the lost-update race
 between sandbox_manager and GenerateSessionSubject, which both run in
 parallel during agent execution.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Delete a session (also cleans up thread and sandbox).

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Get a single session by ID.

methods.name: List
methods.description:
List all sessions with pagination and optional filtering.
 Authorization is handled in-handler via FGA-filtered queries.

methods.name: ListByAgent
methods.description:
List all sessions for a specific agent.
 Authorization is handled in-handler via FGA-filtered queries.
